design.composite: arithmetic mean of defined transport, building and POI components; zero fallback only if none is defined
design.delta: retained-zero scenario composite minus frozen S2 coverage_gap_score
design.frozen_mask: include each frozen-defined fire/EMS/school component iff its provided Overture category count is nonzero; compose facilities-half mean and frozen CBP-proxy half exactly as S2
design.quantile_method: linear interpolation at (n-1)*p; threshold is strict absolute delta > 0.05
design.retain_zero_components: include every frozen-defined fire/EMS/school component irrespective of provided Overture category count, including zero-count types; leave CBP-proxy, transport/building components, and their frozen defined masks unchanged

scenario_hashes.serialization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 concatenated lines `GEOID,<score formatted .17g>\n` in official regional/sample order
